description: This Java abstract class 'StaticContentData' defines a template for static content data objects, including properties such as fileName, contentType, and fileContentType, with relevant getters and setters. It implements Serializable and uses a content type enum from another module.

classes.name: StaticContentData
classes.description: Abstract class for static content data, providing common attributes and methods for handling static content within the CMS module.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this static content.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for this static content.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the file content type as a String.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Assigns the file content type as a String.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type enum value for this static content.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type enum value for this static content.
